original_case: Can uncertainty be the best forecast?
changed_condition: Now suppose the true chance is one half.
viewer_inference: This binary Brier score rewards honest probabilities in expectation. One surprising outcome alone cannot judge a forecaster.
resolution: For Bernoulli truth q, expected binary Brier loss is q(1−q)+(p−q)², uniquely minimized by p=q.
prerequisite: Representations and operations introduced in this film
